name: Grand Royale Hotel & Spa
description: Welcome to the Grand Royale Hotel & Spa. Nestled on private oceanfront bluffs, our luxury resort offers world-class dining, heated infinity pools, full-service spa treatments, and meticulously designed rooms ranging from classic comfort to presidential penthouses.
policies: Check-in from 3:00 PM, Check-out by 11:00 AM
Government-issued photo ID & credit card required at check-in
Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to check-in date
Smoke-free property. Designated outdoor smoking areas available
Pets allowed in select Deluxe and Villa suites with prior deposit
